narrative.overview: A white inset working sheet sits within pale green-grey chrome. Restrained emerald, readable Inter, fine rules, and aligned figures give coffee shop operations a calm hierarchy. Role and branch context guide the owner, manager, and cashier workflows.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet chrome and a bounded working surface
Compact readable tables with tabular figures, branch comparisons, and operational breakdowns
Grouped navigation with role and branch context
Brief state feedback with visible keyboard focus

rules.name: The Operational Accent Rule
rules.body: Use emerald for action and relevant information; avoid decorative accent containers.

rules.name: The Comparable Figures Rule
rules.body: Numeric alignment and consistent formatting take priority over decorative number treatments.

dos: Do reuse shared tokens and components.
Do preserve role context, branch scope, and explicit status labels.
Do keep metric rows aligned at their outer edges, including the owner's eight-cell overview.
Do distinguish current inventory valuation from the selected reporting period.
Do preserve keyboard focus, reduced motion, and mobile touch sizing.
Do reuse Radix Dialog for mobile navigation so closed content unmounts and modal focus, dismissal, and background isolation remain intact.
donts: Don't introduce gradients or a wall of raised cards.
Don't fabricate metrics or simulate AI output.
Don't use color alone to convey operational state.
Don't treat the generated reference as implemented measurements.
